title: Forza Horizon 6
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M4, 32 GB), macOS 27.0, Wine 11 engine r18 release candidate with D3DMetal 4.0b2, 2026-10-05
notes: Plays from the intro through races and free roam on the Wine 11 engine r18 (D3DMetal 4), macOS 27 only. Base M4 at 1080p: 28 fps on High, 38 on Medium with FSR Balanced, 50 on Very Low; 39 to 48 in a race at Medium. The recipe sets the engine and the graphics card D3DMetal reports (the AMD default crashes the game). Xbox sign-in once, by code at microsoft.com/link. Built-in Benchmark Mode shows a black screen. Online play and controllers not tested.

d3dmetal.detail: D3DMetal 4.0b2 only. D3DMetal 3.0 is refused by the game (FH205, no enhanced barriers).

dxmt.detail: DirectX 12 only, DXMT has no DirectX 12

verified.fps: 28 at High native, 33 at High + FSR Balanced, 38 at Medium + FSR Balanced, 44 at Low + FSR Balanced, 50 at Very Low + FSR Balanced, all at 1920x1080 in Tokyo City with the Metal HUD, D3DMetal 4.0b2, base M4
